(MS) | Ask Cleveland Clinic’s Expert 35Likes2,805ViewsApr 212025 For more information about autoimmune diseases, please visit https://cle.clinic/4l17UqC Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic autoimmune condition that affects the brain and spinal cord, causing issues with vision, sensation and movement. There’s no cure for MS, but treatment options can help slow its progression.
